## 5. Zero-run diagnosis: which held-out n-way tuples are unreachable from the words, and why

Zero-fit (`scripts/w21_seed_diagnosis.py`): banks + hold-out design only. Class A = the (agent,door,tint) triple is in train with the same outcome (only the direction is new); B = no triple but all three colour pairs present and agreeing; C = pairs present but conflicting (needs an unseen 3-way interaction); D = a colour pair has ZERO train rows. 'Unidentified' = C or D. 'Reachable by colour relation' = train shows the same colour-EQUALITY pattern (pocket==door / pocket==tint / door==tint, colour-free) with the same colour-free outcome under other colours.
